updates.title: CVE-2026-62916: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID allows attackers to elevate privileges over the network without proper authorization. This is a critical issue affecting identity infrastructure and requires immediate patching to prevent unauthorized access escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-83941: Entra ID Missing Authorization Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A missing authorization flaw in Entra ID enables authorized attackers to escalate their privileges over the network. Admins should review access controls and apply security updates to restrict privilege escalation attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69359: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Domain Services allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges locally on affected systems. Organizations should patch this vulnerability to prevent local privilege escalation attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69524: Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network. This is a critical remote code execution vulnerability requiring urgent patching.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Secure Workflow to Bypass Legal Holds and Retention Policies
updates.summary: A new Priority cleanup feature enables admins to create recurring exceptions for deleting items under retention policies or legal holds on Exchange, requiring a separate security role, multiple approvers, and full audit trail. This addition necessitates a new administrative role for managing privileged deletion workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: DLP protection is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, allowing data security admins to enforce policies across AI and copilot interactions, including blocking sensitive prompts and preventing labeled knowledge sources from being used. This extension protects sensitive data in generative AI workloads with unified policy controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access for Network-Layer File Filtering
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP policies are integrating with Entra Global Secure Access to filter sensitive files at the network layer, enabling organizations to intercept and block sensitive data sharing to untrusted cloud applications, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This integration extends DLP enforcement beyond the application layer to the network perimeter.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
updates.summary: Copilot for Security integration enables DLP admins to gain AI-powered insights on policy coverage, configuration, and effectiveness through natural language prompts. This helps admins quickly validate and refine their DLP posture without manual policy review.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard allows admins to monitor device health status across their endpoint DLP deployment, identifying devices unable to receive policy updates and ensuring readiness for enforcement. This operational visibility helps maintain consistent policy application.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Apply Retention Policy to Microsoft Planner Content
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now create retention policies for Microsoft Planner tasks and plans associated with Microsoft 365 Groups, extending data lifecycle management to collaborative planning workloads. This brings governance parity to previously unmanaged content in Planner.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Insights and Policy Recommendations on Sensitive M365 Data
updates.summary: New insights surface sensitive data detected in OneDrive and SharePoint with recommended retention policies tailored to security and compliance needs. This AI-driven guidance helps admins quickly identify and protect high-risk data at scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard provides MTTA, MTTD, and MTTR metrics with customizable SLA thresholds and trending analysis of DLP alerts by sensitive information type. This operational dashboard helps security teams track incident response performance and identify persistent data exposure trends.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Scalability, Policy Management, and Reporting Enhancements
updates.summary: Purview is expanding auto-labeling capabilities to handle larger SharePoint scopes while improving policy management flexibility and visibility into labeling activity. These enhancements enable enterprise-scale sensitivity label deployment with better control and observability.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: File Labeler and Viewer for macOS
updates.summary: The Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer applications are now available on macOS, bringing sensitivity label support to Mac users with most core functionality except advanced label-based protection. This extends consistent information protection capabilities across operating systems.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Archive File Classification Behavior Change
updates.summary: Archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints is being updated to align with cloud workload handling, reducing noise in event reporting and improving performance when processing archives. This change improves DLP consistency and reduces alert fatigue for large-scale deployments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Support for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies now extend to non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace in preview, using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365. This broadens DLP enforcement across hybrid cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode before enforcement, allowing admins to preview which items would be labeled and validate policy logic without making changes. This reduces the risk of incorrect bulk labeling deployments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Policy Performance Insights Tab
updates.summary: A new Insights tab in auto-labeling policy details provides at-a-glance performance metrics showing match results and source distribution in both simulation and enforcement modes. This visibility helps admins validate policy effectiveness and optimize configurations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Auto-Labeling for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now extend to non-Microsoft applications including Box and Google Workspace in preview, using Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and Purview's classification engine. This enables consistent sensitivity labeling across hybrid cloud platforms.
